mapper.select: select q.id as quId, q.content as quTitle, q.image as quImg, eqa.user_id, eqa.exam_id, eqa.answer_content as answer, GROUP_CONCAT(o.content ORDER BY o.sort SEPARATOR '|||') as refAnswer, COALESCE(eqa.earned_score, eqa.ai_score, 0) as correctScore, eqa.ai_reason as aiReason, COALESCE(eq.score, CASE WHEN eqa.question_type = 5 THEN e.fill_score ELSE e.saq_score END ) as totalScore, eqa.question_type as quType from t_exam_qu_answer as eqa left join t_question as q on eqa.question_id = q.id left join t_option as o on q.id = o.qu_id and (o.is_deleted = 0 or o.is_deleted is null) left join t_exam as e on e.id = eqa.exam_id left join t_exam_question eq on eq.exam_id = eqa.exam_id and eq.question_id = eqa.question_id where (eqa.question_type = 4 or (eqa.question_type = 5 and e.fill_need_mark = 1)) and eqa.user_id = #{userId} and eqa.exam_id = #{examId} group by eqa.id

SELECT q.id as questionId, q.content as questionContent, eq.score as totalScore, o.content as qusetionAnswer, eqa.answer_content as userAnswer FROM t_exam_qu_answer eqa JOIN t_exam_question eq ON eqa.question_id = eq.question_id JOIN t_question q ON eq.question_id = q.id AND q.is_deleted = 0 JOIN t_option o ON o.qu_id = q.id and o.is_deleted = 0 and o.is_right = 1 WHERE eqa.exam_id = #{examId} AND eqa.user_id = #{userId} AND q.qu_type = '4'
